name: agent-roster
description: One shared map from job kind to agent kind for coordinator chats. Native subagents (ticket writer, researcher, lookup, engine and UI implementers, mechanical editor, copy writer, read-only review-gate critics, PR finisher), each pinned to its model, plus a route-work skill with the routing table and coordinator rules, Cursor's thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review skill (vendored, MIT) for the thermonuclear reviewer, and a setup-agentic-workflow skill that installs the worktree, review-gate and merge rules, the ticketing tool setting, the reviewers and two guard hooks into a repo, plus a coordinator prompt template.
